```lean
induction' fin_set_card_lemma using finite_induction on ι with
| empty => 
  simp [encard_empty, sum_finite_empty]
| (i ∪ j) h_i h_j h_disj => 
  have h_union : (⋃ i, s i).encard = (s i).encard + (⋃ j, s j).encard :=
    Set.encard_union_eq h_disj
  rw [h_union, sum_finite_add h_i h_j]
  exact calc
    (s i).encard + (⋃ j, s j).encard = (s i).encard + ∑ᶠ (j : ι), (s j).encard
    by rw [h_i, add_comm]
  done
```
